cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Credit for the Discovery
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you found the clue, saw through the deception, or designed the successful scheme.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll start tomorrow's house tour at the hidden doorway. Say my diagram revealed it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum spent all week stripping that wall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll credit her work first. Then say who spotted the door before she stripped the wall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll let you open it for the visitors.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll open it. Introduce me as the one who found it, though, or they'll just thank me for holding it.

reason: Use an actual tour plan and order of credit; preserve B opening offer as the cause of A distinguishing discovery from door-holding.
